# wso2is_script_library (Resource)

Manages a JavaScript library for adaptive authentication scripts. A script loads the library with `var lib = require('<name>');`. The library shares its functions through `module.exports`. To import, use the library name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_script_library" "risk" {
  name        = "risk.js"
  description = "Risk helpers for adaptive authentication"
  content     = <<-EOT
    function isRisky(score) {
      return score > 70;
    }
    module.exports.isRisky = isRisky;
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) JavaScript source (for example `file("libs/risk.js")`).
- `name` (String) The library name. It must end with `.js`. Changing the name replaces the library.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Library name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_script_library.risk risk.js
```
